graphqlObjectFields: suss: RubyDiscoveryPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby
railsUnderscore: suss: constant-to-path convention name, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby; selects Rails' (Zeitwerk's) underscore rule
stripTypeSuffix: suss: GraphQL type-name convention name, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby; selects graphql-ruby's default_graphql_name rule
field: graphql-ruby: the class-level call declaring one schema field
type: graphql-ruby: the Resolver-class call declaring its return type
argument: graphql-ruby: the class-level call declaring one named argument (also a shared suss name; this note covers the library's use)
mutation: graphql-ruby: field keyword wiring the field to a Mutation class
resolver: graphql-ruby: field keyword wiring the field to a Resolver class (also a shared suss name; this note covers the library's use)
resolve: graphql-ruby: the instance method a Mutation or Resolver class defines to answer the field it is wired to
required: graphql-ruby: argument keyword opting out of the required-by-default registration
camelize: graphql-ruby: field/argument keyword overriding the schema-wide camelize default for that one name
Integer: graphql-ruby: native Ruby class accepted as a convenience synonym for the Int scalar
input: graphql-ruby: the one wire argument RelayClassicMutation wraps a mutation's declared arguments into
dataloader: graphql-ruby: the receiverless call HasDataloader gives a resolver for the request's GraphQL::Dataloader
with: graphql-ruby: the Dataloader method that picks a Source class and its batch arguments
load: graphql-ruby: the Source method that fetches one key through the batch
load_all: graphql-ruby: the Source method that fetches several keys through the batch
request: graphql-ruby: the Source method that queues one key without waiting for it
request_all: graphql-ruby: the Source method that queues several keys without waiting for them
dataload_record: graphql-ruby: the HasDataloader shortcut that loads one ActiveRecord row of the given model by a column
dataload_all_records: graphql-ruby: the HasDataloader shortcut that loads several ActiveRecord rows of the given model by a column
